run_fast_dequantize: run fast_dequantize to dequantize 4-bit or FP8 weight tensors using bitsandbytes CUDA streams
run_fast_gemv: run fast_gemv for fast matrix-vector multiplication where sequence length equals 1 on quantized weights
run_fast_linear_forward: run fast_linear_forward to perform linear projection with optional LoRA weight injection for inference
run_matmul_lora: run matmul_lora to compute matrix multiplication with LoRA adapter weights applied to dequantized base weights
run_get_lora_parameters: run get_lora_parameters to extract base weight, quant state, LoRA A and B matrices, and scaling factor from a projection module
